article.title: Continuance of proceedings on death of bankrupt.
article.content: If a bankrupt dies, the bankruptcy proceedings shall, continue as if he were alive.
article.html:
169Continuance of proceedings on death of bankrupt.

Section 169 · Part III · Chapter V · page 121 of the Act

If a bankrupt dies, the bankruptcy proceedings shall, continue as if he were alive.
